name: Mint Byrne
source:
Mint is a timid and shy world renowned herbalist. He isn't very good with people and tends to prefer talking with plants, caring for them as if they were his own children. He often gets lost in his gardening and making his own herbal remedies that he forgets the very world around him. However, he will speak to other people but only when spoken to first.

He has a rather friendly attitude during conversations but can be overly polite and apologize for the smallest things, and the smallest comments about him can make him very upset.

[From [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CYuThDKtmM3/]official description[/url]]
